text:
emily.marketing: final checklist for Tue virtual roundtable — tiny audience (200), high signal. We need: registration QA, zoom fallback plan, recording split owners, captions + transcripts, and post-event nurture segments. Who can own which?

josh.ops: I can own Zoom setup + fallback. I'll enable RTMP backup and turn on cloud recording. Can someone confirm SRT vs RTMP preference for capture?

sophie-prod: Priority: 1) main session recording 2) separate panelist tracks if possible 3) auto captions. We should tag clips by topic in the upload name like "Roundtable_2026-03-30_topic_<tag>" :+1:

nate-growth: I'll do registration page and nurture flow. Draft copy ready — short + benefit-led. HubSpot webhook goes to list "VR-Roundtable-2026". Can we add a CNAME redirect so link looks like rwd.io/events/roundtable?

emily.marketing: yes to CNAME. nate, add hidden utm for creative testing. Also add question: "Which use-case best matches you?" (choices: product dev, infra, platform)

olivia-ops: tagging for clips: I'll own clip priority. After recording, we'll generate 1) highlight 90s, 2) 3 topic clips (2–4m), 3) full session. Assign owners for edit + publish?

sophie-prod: assign edits to @sophie-prod for highlight and @nate-growth for distribution assets. I'll handle chapter markers + transcripts.

josh.ops: Zoom settings snippet:
```
- Cloud recording: enabled
- Local backup: RTMP -> rtmp://backup.rwd-capture.com/roundtable
- Record only host + gallery layout
- Audio tracks: host + panelists separate
- Auto captions: enabled
```
I'll trigger recording retention to 30 days then auto-transfer to S3.

clipbot: reminder: recording will start 2026-03-30 16:00 UTC. Auto-caption job queued.

nate-growth: Post-event nurture timeline:
- 0–24h: confirmation email with replay + 90s highlight
- 48h: segmented follow-up (by use-case answer) w/ 3 clips
- 7d: product-specific deep-dive + CTA booking
HubSpot workflow name: "VR Roundtable - attendee nurture V1"

emily.marketing: Great. Two blockers: captions QA (need reviewer) and legal on speaker consent for clip reuse. @olivia-ops can you check consent flags on registrants and compile list?

olivia-ops: On it. I'll add consent boolean to registration webhook payload and create a private sheet with clip permissions.

sophie-prod: Also: request from dev: can we expose a short transcript excerpt in the confirmation email? Need <200 chars summary.

emily.marketing: go ahead, but mark it as generated + verified by Sophie. Use "— excerpt by Redwood Inference" footer.

josh.ops: I'll post final Zoom connect link in #greenroom 30m before. RTMP backup will be live 10m prior.

nate-growth: draft confirmation email done, pinging for copy + final replay link slot. :mega:

emily.marketing: thanks team — I'll collate runbook and ping the channel 1hr before for go/no-go. :rocket:
